The tetragonal phase Y12Zn2Se20 (Y6ZnSe10) crystallizes in space group I4/mmm (No. 143) with 34 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zn centers in tetrahedral Se4 coordination, while Y centers show 10-neighbor environments; Se centers have 13 neighbors. Zn tetrahedra share corners with neighboring Se polyhedra, and Se–Y polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
